items.s: Which of the following is the name of one of the five campaigns of Government of Andhra Pradesh?
items.x: The Naidu government's (2014–19) development plan had seven missions, five grids and five campaigns; the five campaigns were Polam Pilustondi, Badi Pilustondi, Pedarikam Pai Gelupu (victory over poverty), Swachh Andhra Pradesh and Neeru-Chettu. Jala Siri, Panta Sanjivani and Arogya Raksha were not among the five campaigns.

items.s: " Every Indian is special. Every Indian is a VIP. " On which occasion did Prime Minister Narendra Modi tweet these words?
o: On abolition of red beacons on vehicles of dignitaries
items.x: On 19 April 2017 the Union Cabinet ended the use of red beacons (lal batti) on the vehicles of VIPs, keeping them only for emergency vehicles; Modi tweeted 'Every Indian is special. Every Indian is a VIP.' It had nothing to do with Yoga Day, BHIM or the UP campaign.

items.s: Bimal Jalan will be First head of :
items.x: Former RBI Governor Bimal Jalan was named (13 August 2014) the first chairman of the Expenditure Management Commission announced in the 2014-15 Budget; the BRICS NDB's first president was K.V. Kamath.

A. BRICS (2023) Chair
B. G20 (2023) Presidency
C. ASEAN (2023) Chair
D. COP 28 (2023) Host

items.src: APPSC General Studies & Mental Ability (Common Paper for Var
items.s: When did the WHO member countries adopt a new International Treaty to enhance global co-ordination and co-operation on pandemic prevention, preparedness and response?
items.x: The 78th World Health Assembly adopted the WHO Pandemic Agreement on 20 May 2025 (Geneva) – the second health treaty under Art. 19 of the WHO Constitution after the FCTC (2003). The annex on pathogen access and benefit-sharing (PABS) was left for further negotiation.

items.src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
items.s: Which of the following countries took full control of its air space in December 2019 for the first time ever after its 1990s war of independence?
items.x: On 4-5 December 2019 Bosnia and Herzegovina (through BHANSA) took control of its entire airspace for the first time since the 1990s war; Croatia, Serbia and Montenegro had managed it till then.

items.src: APPSC General Studies & Mental Ability (Common Paper for Var
items.s: To which country the Indian government has announced $ 300 billion in loans to strengthen maritime security in the year 2024?
items.x: India announced two credit lines totalling US$300 million (US$180 m + US$120 m, Exim Bank) for Vietnam's maritime security during PM Pham Minh Chinh's New Delhi visit on 1 Aug 2024 (the stem's 'billion' is a slip for 'million'). Indonesia, Egypt and France got no such loan.

items.src: APPSC Deputy Educational Officer Screening Test (General Stu
items.s: In April 2024, which of these countries became the first in world to introduce new 5-in-1 vaccine against meningitis?
items.x: In April 2024 WHO announced that Nigeria became the first country to roll out Men5CV (MenFive), a 5-in-1 conjugate vaccine against meningococcal serogroups A, C, W, Y and X, after a serogroup C outbreak. Kenya, Algeria and Sudan were not first.

items.s: Which is the first ' carbon neutral ' international airport in Asia-Pacific?
items.x: Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport became the first carbon-neutral airport in the Asia-Pacific region in September 2016 (ACI Airport Carbon Accreditation Level 3+ 'Neutrality'); it later became Asia-Pacific's first Level 4+ airport. Mumbai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad came later.

items.s: In the Climate Risk Index 2026 (Germanwatch), what was India's rank among the most affected countries (1995–2024)?
items.x: India was 9th most affected; Dominica was 1st.

items.s: What is India's ranking in the Global Peace Index-2014, published by Institute of Economics and Peace?
items.x: In the 8th Global Peace Index (June 2014) of the Institute for Economics and Peace, India was 143rd of 162 countries (score 2.571), two places lower than in 2013; Iceland was the most peaceful. 162 is the number of countries covered, not India's rank. (India was 115th in GPI 2025 and 127th of 163 in GPI 2026.)

items.s: According to INTERPOL, which State police had registered one of the first cases in India of human trafficking committed to force victims to commit cyber fraud?
items.x: INTERPOL's Operation Storm Makers II (late 2023) reported that police in Telangana registered one of India's first cases of human trafficking for the purpose of cyber fraud: an accountant lured to Southeast Asia was forced to run online scams and freed only after a ransom. The other States are not named in the INTERPOL release.

items.s: Which country is at the highest level of happiness according to the United Nations 'World Happiness Report, 2015’?
items.x: The World Happiness Report 2015 (UN SDSN) ranked Switzerland 1st (7.587), followed by Iceland (2nd) and Denmark (3rd); Denmark had topped the 2012 and 2013 reports. (Finland has been 1st since 2018 – 9th straight year in 2026.)

items.s: As per World Happiness Report, 2017 of UNO, what is the rank of India in the Global Happiness Rankings?
items.x: In the World Happiness Report 2017 India was 122nd of 155 countries, four places below its 2016 rank (118th); Norway was the happiest. In 2018 India slipped to 133rd. (In 2026 India is 116th of 147.)

items.s:
Match the states in column A with the cases reported in column B, as per the report of the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) available up to the year 2021 for north-eastern states of India published by the Ministry of Home Affairs in March 2023.
Column A (State):

I. Manipur

II. Nagaland

III. Arunachal Pradesh
Column B (Cases reported):

a. 3

b. 1

c. 0
items.x: The printed key matches Manipur with 1 case, Nagaland with 0 and Arunachal Pradesh with 3 (I-b, II-c, III-a). The stem does not say which crime head of the NCRB 2021 data is meant, so the figures could not be checked against the report.

items.s: Which organisation publishes the Press Freedom Index?
o: Institute for Economics and Peace, Sydney
items.x: RSF, Paris, publishes the Press Freedom Index; IEP publishes the Global Peace Index.

items.s: Which organisation publishes the Network Readiness Index?
items.x: The NRI is by the Portulans Institute; the USA topped NRI 2025.

items.s: Which institution publishes the Air Quality Life Index (AQLI) 2025?
items.x: AQLI is by EPIC, Chicago; IQAir publishes the World Air Quality Report and HEI–IHME the State of Global Air.

items.s: What weight do GHG emissions carry in the Climate Change Performance Index?
items.x: CCPI weights: GHG 40%, renewables 20%, energy use 20%, climate policy 20%.

items.s: In NIRF, what weight does the Teaching-Learning parameter carry?
items.x: NIRF weights: Teaching-Learning 30%, Research 30%, Graduation Outcomes 20%, Outreach 10%, Perception 10%.

items.s: The writer of ‘Bikhare Moti’ is :
items.x: 'Bikhre Moti' is a Hindi short-story collection by Subhadra Kumari Chauhan (also author of 'Unmadini', 'Seedhe-Saade Chitra' and the poem 'Jhansi ki Rani'). Muktibodh, Agyeya and Dinkar Sonwalkar did not write it.

B. Shri Ramen Deka
C. Shri P.S. Sreedharan Pillai
States (List-2):

2. Chhattisgarh
3. Goa

Sreedharan Pillai left Goa in July 2025 and Arif Mohammed Khan left Bihar in March 2026 — now Goa: Pusapati Ashok Gajapathi Raju (sworn in 26 July 2025); Bihar: Syed Ata Hasnain (Praveen CA-360 Mar 2026 p.16)
As of March 2025: Arif Mohammed Khan – Bihar (from January 2025), Ramen Deka – Chhattisgarh (from July 2024), P.S. Sreedharan Pillai – Goa, so A-1, B-2, C-3. (now Bihar – Lt Gen (Retd) Syed Ata Hasnain, March 2026; Goa – Pusapati Ashok Gajapathi Raju, 26 July 2025.) (Persons-in-news PYQ: moved to row 115.)
